housing-numbers.notes: Policy CS3 sets minimum net target of 8,100 dwellings between 2010-2028 at 450 dwellings per annum. Document notes shortage of land in urban area requiring Green Belt release. Spatial distribution: Huyton/Stockbridge Village (36%), Kirkby (16%), Prescot/Whiston/Cronton/Knowsley Village (32%), Halewood (16%). Housing trajectory shows delivery from various sources including commitments, allocations, SHLAA sites and Sustainable Urban Extensions.
